title: Transport along the pullback preserves K-flat complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of
schemes. The transport
$\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{f^*\Lambda_Y}$ along
the strong monoidal pullback of abelian sheaves ([sk-def-sfb-transport],
[def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal]) sends K-flat complexes ([sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]) of
$\Lambda_Y$-modules to K-flat complexes of $f^*\Lambda_Y$-modules, for the relative
tensor products of [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor].

proof.text: Apply the proved generic-coefficient pro-étale pullback theorem to the commutative ring object condensedRingObj Λ Y. The generic theorem contains the internal/section comparison and conservative-stalk argument; this specialization preserves exactly the original instance signature.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of
schemes. The transport
$\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{f^*\Lambda_Y}$ along
the strong monoidal pullback of abelian sheaves ([det-def-sfb-transport],
[sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]) sends K-flat complexes ([det-def-sfb-derived-categories]) of
$\Lambda_Y$-modules to K-flat complexes of $f^*\Lambda_Y$-modules, for the relative
tensor products of [det-prop-sfb-module-category].

proof.text:
The functor $\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})$ is the pullback of modules along the
morphism of ringed topoi $(X_{\mathrm{proét}},f^*\Lambda_Y)\to
(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda_Y)$ whose inverse image is $f^*_{\Ab}$. Since $f^*_{\Ab}$
is exact, strong monoidal and commutes with colimits
([sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]), it commutes with the relative tensor
product of complexes of module objects (a coequalizer of tensor products, followed by
totalization, [det-prop-sfb-module-category]) and preserves acyclicity. That the
pullback of a K-flat complex along a morphism of ringed topoi is K-flat is then the
general statement of the Stacks Project (Cohomology on Sites, section on K-flat
complexes): one tests $f^*P\otimes_{f^*\Lambda_Y}N$ against an arbitrary acyclic
complex $N$ of $f^*\Lambda_Y$-modules on $X$, not only against pulled-back ones, by
reducing to the K-flat complexes built from the functorial flat resolutions
$\Lambda_Y\otimes Q$ of [det-prop-sfb-module-category], whose pullbacks
$f^*\Lambda_Y\otimes f^*_{\Ab}Q$ are again of this form with $f^*_{\Ab}Q$ flat.
